jobs.title: Computer Engineering Expert - AI Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Computer Engineering Expert — AI Content Specialist

About The Role

We're looking for computer engineering experts to help train and improve the next generation of AI models. At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research labs — and we need people who truly understand hardware, systems, and low-level software to make these models smarter, more accurate, and more reliable.

This is a rare opportunity to apply deep technical knowledge in a flexible, remote freelance role that directly shapes how AI reasons about computer architecture, embedded systems, and hardware design.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Design Complex Technical Challenges — Create advanced computer engineering problems spanning RISC-V/ARM architecture, FPGA development, memory management, and hardware-software co-design
Author Ground-Truth Solutions — Write rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions including assembly code, HDL snippets, and architectural diagrams that serve as reference-quality "golden responses" for AI training
Audit AI-Generated Content — Evaluate AI outputs across C/C++, Verilog, VHDL, logic gate designs, and OS kernels for technical accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to industry standards
Identify and Fix Reasoning Errors — Spot logical flaws in AI reasoning — race conditions, memory leaks, improper timing constraints — and provide structured feedback to improve model performance
Stress-Test AI Capabilities — Challenge models on topics like computer architecture, embedded systems and IoT, networking and distributed systems, hardware security, and operating systems, documenting failure modes to harden model reasoning

Who You Are

Pursuing or completed a Master's or PhD in Computer Engineering, Computer Science (hardware focus), or a closely related field
Strong foundational expertise in one or more of: Computer Architecture, Embedded Systems, Digital Logic Design, or Operating Systems
Able to communicate highly technical hardware and low-level software concepts clearly and concisely in writing
Exceptionally detail-oriented — comfortable reasoning about bit-level operations, clock-cycle timing, and precise technical documentation
Self-motivated and reliable working independently on a flexible schedule
No prior AI experience required

Nice to Have

Experience with data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
Proficiency in engineering tools such as MATLAB, ANSYS, or similar platforms
Background in hardware security, FPGA toolchains, or real-time embedded systems

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside top research labs and AI teams
Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, anywhere in the world
Freelance autonomy: choose your hours, your pace, and your workload (10–40 hrs/week)
Gain firsthand exposure to how large language models are built and trained
Contribute meaningfully to AI systems that will influence the future of technical reasoning
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension

jobs.title: Finance Subject Matter Expert — AI Model Reviewer
jobs.description:
About The Role

What if your deep knowledge of financial modeling could directly shape how AI performs the work of a professional analyst? We're looking for Finance Subject Matter Experts who also know their way around Python and GitHub to audit, refine, and improve AI-generated financial modeling tasks — making sure they mirror how real analysts actually work.

You'll review AI task instructions and scoring rubrics, then roll up your sleeves and edit Markdown files and Python scripts directly via Pull Requests to fix logic errors, close clarity gaps, and ensure every task meets professional standards. If you can build a DCF in your sleep and know your way around a P&L, this role was made for you.

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. Candidates must have strong US-based financial knowledge and fluency with American financial terminology and conventions.

Organization: Alignerr
Type: Hourly Contract
Location: Remote
Compensation: $80–$110/hour
Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

Audit AI-generated financial modeling tasks to ensure they accurately replicate professional analyst workflows
Validate task instructions and scoring rubrics for logical soundness, completeness, and real-world relevance
Directly edit Markdown files and Python scripts via Pull Requests to resolve logic errors, ambiguity, or clarity gaps
Evaluate whether AI outputs reflect correct application of concepts like DCF analysis, P&L interpretation, financial statement modeling, and valuation techniques
Provide clear, structured feedback grounded in professional financial expertise
Collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team using GitHub-based workflows
Work independently on task-based assignments at your own pace and schedule

Who You Are

Deep subject matter expertise in finance — you've worked as an analyst, in investment banking, corporate finance, equity research, FP&A, or a closely related field
Strong command of US-based financial terminology and frameworks (DCF, P&L, balance sheet analysis, WACC, comparable company analysis, etc.)
Proficient in Python — comfortable reading, writing, and debugging scripts used for financial calculations
Experienced with GitHub — you can clone repos, create branches, and submit Pull Requests without hand-holding
Comfortable editing Markdown for technical documentation
Detail-oriented with a systematic, quality-driven approach to review work
Clear, precise written communicator who can articulate what's wrong and why
Self-motivated and reliable when working independently

Nice to Have

CFA, CPA, or MBA with a finance concentration
Professional experience building financial models in Excel or Python for deal evaluation, forecasting, or valuation
Background in teaching, mentoring, or creating training materials for financial concepts
Familiarity with AI/ML evaluation workflows or data annotation projects
Experience writing or reviewing technical rubrics or assessment criteria

Why Join Us

Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs
Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high-impact task-based work
Apply your hard-earned financial expertise to a genuinely novel problem — teaching AI to think like a real analyst
Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

UC San Diego values and welcomes people from all backgrounds. If you are interested in being part of our team, possess the needed licensure and certifications, and feel that you have most of the qualifications and/or transferable skills for a job opening, we strongly encourage you to apply.

This position is a part-time limited position with the possibility of extension/career conversion.

Reassignment Applicants : Eligible Reassignment clients should contact their Disability Counselor for assistance.

Description

The UC San Diego Department of Psychiatry ranks among the nation's leading academic psychiatry departments, recognized for its exceptional research enterprise, innovative clinical programs, and outstanding educational training. Our faculty and staff are driving meaningful advances in mental health science, delivering transformative patient care, and shaping the next generation of clinicians and researchers. We offer a collegial, high-achieving work environment where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and contribute to work that matters.

Under supervision, the Lab Assistant will assist with a number of duties for research studies focusing on mindfulness and psychedelics as a treatment for addiction and chronic pain within UCSD ONEMIND in the Department of Psychiatry. Major responsibilities will include recruiting, assisting with preparing and deploying substance use assessments, assisting with the administration and scoring of clinical rating scales, psychophysiological assessments, physical measurements, preparation and processing of data charts for computerized entry, and entry of data into clinical research database system; and retention efforts for multiple longitudinal studies, working as part of a research team to retain study participants. Perform other general research tasks, such as: library and computer research, and general administrative and office tasks.

Minimum Qualifications

Graduation from high school or a General Education Diploma and two years of laboratory experience or two years of college including courses in the natural, physical or social sciences and one year of laboratory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; and knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.
Demonstrated understanding of psychology, substance use disorders, and DSM-V criteria for psychiatric disorders.
Experience working in psychiatric research environments.
Experience in working with and scoring of clinical rating scales and psychophysiological tests, or willingness to learn.
Proficiency using PC's including relational databases, word processing, spreadsheet, and statistical analysis programs.
Must be able to maintain confidentiality.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a multi-cultural environment.
Ability to sustain careful attention to detail for long periods of time.
Demonstrated skill in organizing, analyzing, managing time, setting priorities and meeting deadlines for multiple tasks.
Willingness to travel to addiction treatment clinics to recruit, consent, and assess participants.
Proven ability to enter data into relational databases in an accurate and precise manner.

Preferred Qualifications

Ability to design and maintain logs; develop reports and tables.

SPECIAL CONDITIONS

Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Must be willing to work with both a psychiatric population and an addiction treatment research population.
Must have ready access to reliable transportation and be willing to travel off-site to conduct assessments.
Must be willing to work occasional overtime, weekends or flexible schedule.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.

Pay Transparency Act

Annual Full Pay Range: $57,504 - $69,175 (will be prorated if the appointment percentage is less than 100%)

Hourly Equivalent: $27.54 - $33.13

Factors in determining the appropriate compensation for a role include experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs. The Hiring Pay Scale referenced in the job posting is the budgeted salary or hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position. The Annual Full Pay Range may be broader than what the University anticipates to pay for this position, based on internal equity, budget, and collective bargaining agreements (when applicable).

Apply Now

If employed by the University of California, you will be required to comply with our Policy on Vaccination Programs, which may be amended or revised from time to time. Federal, state, or local public health directives may impose additional requirements.

If applicable, life-support certifications (BLS, NRP, ACLS, etc.) must include hands-on practice and in-person skills assessment; online-only certification is not acceptable.

UC San Diego Health Sciences is comprised of our School of Medicine, Skaggs School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences, The Herbert Wertheim School of Public Health and Human Longevity Science, and our Student Health and Well-Being Department. We have long been at the forefront of translational — or "bench-to-bedside" — research, transforming patient care through discovery and innovation leading to new drugs and technologies. Translational research is carried out every day in the hundreds of clinical trials of promising new therapies offered through UC San Diego Health, and in the drive of our researchers and clinician-scientists who are committed to having a significant impact on patient care. We invite you to join our team!

Reassignment Applicants : Eligible Reassignment clients should contact their Disability Counselor for assistance.

Description

The UC San Diego Department of Psychiatry ranks among the nation's leading academic psychiatry departments, recognized for its exceptional research enterprise, innovative clinical programs, and outstanding educational training. Our faculty and staff are driving meaningful advances in mental health science, delivering transformative patient care, and shaping the next generation of clinicians and researchers. We offer a collegial, high-achieving work environment where talented professionals are empowered to grow, collaborate, and contribute to work that matters.

Under supervision, the Lab Assistant will assist with a number of duties for research studies focusing on mindfulness and psychedelics as a treatment for addiction and chronic pain within UCSD ONEMIND in the Department of Psychiatry. Major responsibilities will include recruiting, assisting with preparing and deploying substance use assessments, assisting with the administration and scoring of clinical rating scales, psychophysiological assessments, physical measurements, preparation and processing of data charts for computerized entry, and entry of data into clinical research database system; and retention efforts for multiple longitudinal studies, working as part of a research team to retain study participants. Perform other general research tasks, such as: library and computer research, and general administrative and office tasks.

Minimum Qualifications

Graduation from high school or a General Education Diploma and two years of laboratory experience or two years of college including courses in the natural, physical or social sciences and one year of laboratory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience; and knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.
Demonstrated understanding of psychology, substance use disorders, and DSM-V criteria for psychiatric disorders.
Experience working in psychiatric research environments.
Experience in working with and scoring of clinical rating scales and psychophysiological tests, or willingness to learn.
Proficiency using PC's including relational databases, word processing, spreadsheet, and statistical analysis programs.
Must be able to maintain confidentiality.
Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a multi-cultural environment.
Ability to sustain careful attention to detail for long periods of time.
Demonstrated skill in organizing, analyzing, managing time, setting priorities and meeting deadlines for multiple tasks.
Willingness to travel to addiction treatment clinics to recruit, consent, and assess participants.
Proven ability to enter data into relational databases in an accurate and precise manner.

Preferred Qualifications

Ability to design and maintain logs; develop reports and tables.

SPECIAL CONDITIONS

Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical.
Must be willing to work with both a psychiatric population and an addiction treatment research population.
Must have ready access to reliable transportation and be willing to travel off-site to conduct assessments.
Must be willing to work occasional overtime, weekends or flexible schedule.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs.
